calls.title: Jeremy/Ashley
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team outlined their strategy for engaging customers with tailored AI feature discussions, emphasizing customized presentations to gather feedback on valuable AI capabilities. They discussed the selection of Clickhouse for its superior speed and cost-effectiveness, making it suitable for real-time queries and operational agility. Additionally, the team is working on improving data access to billing and subscription metrics while tracking open-source usage through telemetry data. A focus on experimentation and feature flagging was highlighted, targeting mid-market and enterprise customers to secure substantial deals. Participants also addressed team organization with responsibilities and prioritization, including key roles for James and Kevin, while developing AI-driven automation to enhance workflows without over-relying on AI for decision-making.
calls.keywords: AI capabilities, Clickhouse, telemetry data, Functional Technical Review, experimentation, product analytics
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Share the tailored AI capabilities slide with customers and solicit feedback on the most valuable features for them (01:50)

**Jeremy Dorn**
Customize presentation slides on AI functionalities to match customer profiles before meetings (02:10)
Prepare presentation on Clickhouse’s selection rationale and benefits for the joint webinar scheduled for September 17th (06:40)
Follow up on ORB’s data warehouse integration, confirm Hex access to ORB data via S3 (10:30)
Inform James about Functional Technical Review (FTR) for version 5.0 and coordinate timing after European compliance tasks (13:00)

**James**
Locate and extract telemetry data on open-source usage, focusing on IP addresses in Clickhouse filtered by self-hosted events (11:40)

**Kevin**
Support marketing and sales enablement by developing self-serve admin tools and internal Slack bots (14:15)

**Guy**
Manage onboarding process for Pro version (15:05)

**Leadership team**
Schedule a follow-up meeting with marketing and product leads (Alyssa, Scott, Luke) to align on messaging strategy, particularly to position product analytics as complementary to experimentation and feature flagging (21:50)
